87275: Ken Kaneki was originally a human and a normal college student until he encountered a female ghoul named Rize who was posing as a human at the time.
87277: Touka is a ghoul successfully posing as a human and working as a waitress at a cafe which serves as a gathering place for other ghouls, as well as a food resource. She saves Kaneki's life at one point and acts as a reluctant guide to him and his adaptation to the ghoul society.
88293: Hinami is a child ghoul whose parents were killed by ghoul investigators. Before, she and her mother seek help from the owner of the Antique Cafe to acquire food. Hinami is initially quite shy, but when she opens up, she is cheerful and earnest.
88407: A first class police investigator who investigates Ghouls, also known as a Dove. He comes to the 20th ward with his mentor, Mado Kureo, to investigate Ghoul incidents in the area.
88408: A Special Class Ghoul Investigator. In the past, he acted as Koutarou Amon's instructor at the Academy.
88409: Nishiki Nishio is a ghoul whose original feeding ground was taken from Rize. He is a sophomore in the Pharmaceutical Department of Kamii University and Kimi Nishino's boyfriend.
88410: Kimi Nishino is a assistant for Akihiro Kanou who aids in his ghoulification experiments, the previous human lover of Nishiki Nishio and a medical student at Kamii University.
88411: Ayato Kirishima is Touka Kirishima's younger brother. He grew up with his sister in the 20th ward but at some point of time, he disappeared. Currently, he is an executive of Aogiri Tree. An arrogant youth with a similar harsh attitude that resembles his sister.
88412: A Rank 3 Ghoul Investigator. In the past, he went by the name Rei Suzuya. He is the partner of Yukinori Shinohara. He is a young man with androgynous appearance. He has many stitches used as both first-aid and fashion.
88413: Rize Kamishiro is a ghoul that was hanging out at Anteiku. She set her eyes on Ken Kaneki, but moments before eating him, she died in an accident and her organs were transplanted in Ken Kaneki, making him half-ghoul.
88414: A ghoul that has his own art studio where he makes masks for other ghouls. He has a lot of piercings and tattoos on his body, making him look pretty intimidating, even as a normal-looking human. He's the one who also made a mask for Kaneki.
88415: Itori is an old friend of Yomo and Uta. She can be found in Helter Skelter bar, where she makes her share in the information web of the underworld. Itori is over friendly and talkative. She likes having fun and even doing pranks.
88416: Enji Koma is a ghoul and a waiter at Anteiku. He is an expert coffee brewer. In his youth, he was known as the Devil Ape and led the Apes ghoul gang.
88417: Taro is a scrapper of the Ghoul Restaurant and owned by Madam A.
88418: A direct subordinate of the One-Eyed King and one of Aogiri Tree's leaders. He was a former member of the Chinese ghoul organization Chi She Lian.
88419: A gay ghoul (okama) in love. He was once acting together with Yamori and participating in Aogiri Tree.
88421: Hideyoshi is a normal human and the best friend of Ken Kaneki. Hide is incredibly observant and can figure things out about people in a almost sherlock-like manner. He also becomes interested in things and works hard on them until he finds something else to interest him.
88423: A senior first class investigator, or a "Dove," who hunts Ghouls. He is Amon's mentor and partner. He hunts Ghouls with a maniacal glee, and believes that all Ghouls are lesser than humans, calling them "trash," and mocking them for trying to "imitate" human behavior.
88424: Shuu Tsukiyama was the infamous Gourmet ghoul of the 20th ward. He was a fourth-year student studying Social Welfare at the Department of Human Sciences at Seinan Gakuin University.
88428: A white-haired brute with sharp lizard eyes. Yamori is ghoul who is as scary as he looks. Normally in a entirely white suit and black dress shirt, he resembles a typical gangster.
88838: Akira Mado is a Rank 2 Ghoul Investigator and Kureo's daughter. She is currently partnered with Koutarou Amon. She is an intelligent woman and seems to be always serious about work and her daily routine in general.
88872: Saiko Yonebayashi is a Rank 3 Ghoul Investigator, a Quinx, and a member of the Quinx Squad. She dislikes having to work, as she prefers having a peaceful, happy-go-lucky and carefree life by playing video games and eating junk food excessively.
88886: Tooru Mutsuki is a Rank 3 Ghoul Investigator, a Quinx and a member of the Quinx Squad. Tooru is kind with a gentle heart and seems to be shy with little self-confidence. Having a constant case of Anemia, ironically, Mutsuki feels repulsive when he comes into contact with blood.
88887: Ginshi Shirazu is a Rank 3 Ghoul Investigator, a Quinx and the Current Squad Leader of the Quinx Squad. Shirazu, like most of his teammates, is shown to have great respect for his mentor, Haise Sasaki.
88935: He is a Rank 2 Ghoul Investigator,a Quinx and the former Squad Leader of the Quinx Squad. Urie often displays himself as a cool-headed individual, holding a monotonous facial expression the majority of the time.
88946: Kishou Arima is a famed Special Class Ghoul Investigator known as the CCG's Reaper. He is undefeated as a Ghoul Investigator and at some point was formerly partnered with Take Hirako.
90231: Eto is an executive of Aogiri Tree from the 24th ward. Eto is often seen interacting with fellow Aogiri member Tatara.
90232: Naki is a ghoul who was imprisoned in Cochlea until Aogiri Tree's invasion on the prison. He was liberated by Aogiri Tree due to being a direct underling and supposedly the right hand man of Yamori. He was almost always accompanied by the Twins Gagi and Guge.
90234: Hairu Ihei is a First Class Ghoul investigator and the partner of Koori Ui. She is the deputy leader of S1 Squad. She is a veteran of the Owl Suppression Operation and serves as a member of Squad 0, commanded by Kishou Arima.
90236: Kurona Yasuhisa is an artificial one-eyed ghoul who impeded Ken Kaneki's pursuit of Madam A alongside her twin sister Nashiro.
90237: Nashiro Yasuhisa is an artificial one-eyed ghoul who impeded Ken Kaneki's pursuit of Madam A alongside her twin sister Kurona.
121595: Chie is a human photographer and information broker. She is a long-time friend of Shuu Tsukiyama, aware of his secret but uninterested in exposing him as a Ghoul. At his request, she serves as an informant to Kaneki's group.
124971: Kanae von Rosewald is a Ghoul and the last survivor of the Rosewald family. After Matsuri Washuu led an extermination operation to destroy the Rosewalds, Kanae was taken in as an employee of the Tsukiyama family.
125567: He is one of the direct subordinates of the King of an Eye and one of the leaders of the Aogiri Tree, next to Tatara. In the past he was called Noroi and was responsible for raising Eto, when Kuzen surrendered in District 24.
125884: Takizawa is a Rank 2 Ghoul Investigator. A classmate of Akira Mado at the Academy, he is partnered with Kousuke Houji and assigned to the 20th ward to investigate the Gourmet. He greatly respects Kishou Arima and Koutarou Amon and admires their achievements.
136023: Take Hirako is a First Class Ghoul Investigator. In the past, he formed a duo with Kishou Arima. Hirako is of average height and his facial features have been described as "plain" or "bland." He usually has a blank expression on his face.
136024: Yoshimura is a ghoul and the manager of the Anteiku cafe. He tries to help every ghoul, especially those who can't hunt themselves. He takes in Ken Kaneki and tries to help him survive being a ghoul.
145217: Taishi Fura is a First-Class Ghoul Investigator. He is the protagonist of the side story Tokyo Ghoul: Jack, alongside Kishou Arima.
145218: Ryou was the childhood friend of Taishi Fura and Aki Sasada.
145219: Itsuki is a Special Class Ghoul Investigator. He is the commander of the 11th Ward Special Countermeasures Unit and Chief of Division II.
145221: Aki is the childhood friend of Taishi and Ryou's girlfriend.
145222: Minami Uruka is a second-year student at Seishin Senior High School. She is a classmate of Kishou Arima and Taishi Fura.
167631: Kousuke is a Special Class Investigator and a former partner of Kureo Mado prior to a major assignment in China. He was previously assigned to the 20th Ward as the partner of Seidou Takizawa and worked on the Gourmet case.
169534: Koori is a Special Class Investigator and an Investigation Commander in Division I. He is the leader of S1 Squad, and a former protege of Kishou Arima and the partner of Hairu Ihei. He is in charge of the 4th ward.
172074: Renji Yomo is a worker at Anteiku and the right hand of Yoshimura. He is an old friend of Uta and Itori. Because of his scavenging habits and long-beaked, avian mask, he has the nickname of "Raven."
189324: Hikari was the mother of Touka and Ayato Kirishima. Arata Kirishima was her husband.
189325: Akihiro Kanou, often referred to as Professor Kanou, is a physician at Kanou General Hospital.
189326: Father of Touka Kirishima and Ayato Kirishima. Virtuous and gentle, Arata is a pacifist ghoul who is content to live peacefully with humans and wants the same for his children.
195607: Donato Porpora is a Russian ghoul and a prisoner in the 23rd ward's Ghoul Detention Center. He was once running a Catholic orphanage in Japan. His alias was Priest (神父). He was also Koutarou Amon's foster father.
206156: Kuramoto Itou is a First Class Ghoul Investigator and the deputy squad leader of the Hirako Squad.
206157: Mayu, also known as Nutcracker, was a ghoul that preyed on men by crushing their testicles before drinking the fluids. She was tasked with capturing humans for an underground "Gourmet" society.
206209: Hetare is a cockatiel parrot who lived in Anteiku prior to its destruction. Hetare is a plump bird with pale, yellow feathers and grey wings. As is common with cockatiels, he has orange circles on his cheeks, and a wispy crest protruding from the top of his head.
207563: The grumpy cat of Akira Mado. She appears to be affectionate towards Akira, but hostile to anyone else.
235080: An Associate Special Class Investigator from the CCG.
236716: Matsumae is a teacher at Seinan Gakuin High School and the homeroom teacher of Shuu Tsukiyama. She is also a Ghoul in the employment of the Tsukiyama family. She's responsible for keeping an eye on Tsukiyama while acting as his teacher.
236717: Ikaru is a Ghoul, and a classmate of Shuu Tsukiyama at Seinan Gakuin University.
241525: Kouitsu Chigyou is the head ghoul researcher at CCG Laboratory Division. He used to be a researcher in the GFG in Germany.
241526: Maiko is a member of the Ghoul Restaurant
241529: Kaya Irimi is a waitress working at Anteiku.
241530: Ayumu is a First Class Investigator from the CCG and Vice-Chief of Chuu Hachikawa's squad. Ayumu was part of the Squad 3 in the Anteiku raid.
241531: Misato Gori is a Rank 2 Ghoul Investigator. She is currently affiliated with the 13th ward.
241532: Kiyoko is a Special Class Investigator, and noteworthy for being the first woman to achieve that rank. She is assigned to the 1st Ward as the Chief of Division I . She was a classmate of Kasuka Mado, and is greatly admired by the female employees of CCG for her many achievements.
241535: Matasaka Kamishiro is a SS-rank ghoul and the former leader of the ghouls in the 6th ward. Most people refer to him by his nickname Orca or Shachi. He is a strong ghoul, well-versed in the martial arts.
241536: Ippei Kusaba was a Rank 3 Bureau Investigator working at CCG's branch in the 20th ward and the partner of Yasunori Nakajima.
241539: Iwao Kuroiwa is a Special Class Ghoul Investigator. Currently, he serves as the vice commander of the 11th Ward Special Countermeasures Unit. Yukinori Shinohara calls him by the nickname Iwaccho.
241540: Roma Hoito is a ghoul and used to be a waitress at Anteiku.
241541: Yasunori Nakajima is a bureau investigator working at CCG's branch in the 20th ward and was the partner of Ippei Kusaba.
241542: Masked ghoul brothers and executives of Aogiri Tree. Most of the ghouls in the 11th ward of Aogiri Tree are their subordinates. It is said they strongly believe in the one eyed king's ideology. Their Kagune is of the Bikaku type.
241543: Nobu was a First Class Ghoul Investigator and led his own Squad. Until recently, he worked on the Torso case, along with the Quinx Squad.
241544: Masked ghoul brothers and executives of Aogiri Tree. Most of the ghouls in the 11th ward of Aogiri Tree are their subordinates. It is said they strongly believe in the one eyed king's ideology. Their Kagune is of the Bikaku type.
241545: Katsuya Mabuchi is a ghoul investigator. He is the subordinate of Itsuki Marude and is normally seen standing beside Marude.
241546: Taguchi is a nurse at Kanou General Hospital.
241547: Goumasa Tokage is a combat instructor at the 2nd Academy.
241549: Souta was a member of the Ghoul Restaurant, where he went by the alias PG. He hides his face with a clown mask.
241550: Kazuo Yoshida is a ghoul who Ken met in a dark alley and moments later was killed by Nishiki Nishio since he was feeding on his turf. He also appeared in omake at the end of some volumes and worked as Chief Instructor in the Fitness Club "ZEN."
241551: Mougan is a Special Class Investigator and the Division I Branch Director of CCG's 2nd Ward Branch Office. He acted as the captain of Squad 2 in the Anteiku raid.
241552: Yoshitoki Washuu is the current Bureau Director of CCG's Main Office and Tsuneyoshi Washuu's son.
241553: Hisashi Ogura is a ghoul researcher. He often goes on TV programs to speak about them.
241555: Tsuneyoshi Washuu is the current chairman of CCG and Yoshitoki Washuu's father.
250540: She's a ghoul and a former executive of Aogiri Tree. She is known by the alias Three Blades (三枚刃, Sanmaiba) in reference to the shape of her kagune. She was the leader of the 18th ward and the Blades gang.
259906: Keijin is a First Class Ghoul Investigator. He is the Vice-Squad Leader of CCG's Suzuya Squad that's assigned to the 13th Ward.
278926: Ching-Li Hsiao is a Taiwanese Rank 1 Ghoul Investigator and one of the second batch of recruits to the Quinx Squad.
282392: Mirumo Tsukiyama (月山観母) is an extremely wealthy and eccentric ghoul, well-known within ghoul society for being extravagant. He is the father of Shuu Tsukiyama, and took part in the auction as a major bidder under the alias Croque Monsieur.
